create_llm_training_params: create an LLMTrainingParams instance to configure causal language model training with default settings
configure_peft_lora_params: configure LLMTrainingParams with PEFT and LoRA settings for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
set_dpo_training_params: set LLMTrainingParams for DPO training with a reference model and beta value
configure_quantization_params: configure LLMTrainingParams with int4 quantization and target modules for memory-efficient training
set_hub_push_params: set LLMTrainingParams to push the trained model to Hugging Face Hub with authentication
